title: A Cover for the Asset
author: Oscar Nakamura
blurb: Rafael Coldharbour, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
